methodology: Reconstructed sequential baseline: same current safety/supervision, no warm cache, inline npm audit, agent-selected blocking sequential installs, no install/inspection overlap or early handoff. Not an exact historical version.
Optimized: frozen current worker/agent/tool code, warm template, audit deferred, overlapping inspection, independent npm/pip parallel option, compact install-state replies and early-launch handoff.
Fresh sequential E2B instances; alternate baseline/optimized order by round; rotate repository order. 8 CPU / 8192 MiB required.
Same pinned repository revision asserted after normal clone. Same local Claude subscription/CLI and configured model. No API fallback.
Clock covers worker request to ready plus independent public HTTP 200 HTML check. Artifact collection/cleanup excluded. No UI/IPC/browser-paint timing.
No app secrets supplied; live frontend preview is not verification of secret-dependent backend features.
Existing user previews, configuration, repository worktree and published templates are never modified.
